profiles.name: Cyn Starter
profiles.author: Cyn contributors
profiles.description: Beat-responsive bass and more vocal presence. Synthetic feature training only; personalize with More/Less.

profiles.name: Cyn Cinema AI
profiles.author: Cyn contributors
profiles.description: Experimental Movie & Series profile: dialogue-forward Clarity and restrained Bass; synthetic-feature-trained, not speech-aware. Start here and teach your preferences with More/Less.

profiles.name: Cyn Real Audio 13h (Experimental)
profiles.author: Cyn contributors
profiles.description: 13 hours of neural training on real spoken audio and instrument notes. Better heuristic prediction on a held-out set; actual listening quality has not been verified. Import to try it without changing your current model until you select it.

profiles.name: CYN APEX-6M FlowSense (Research)
profiles.author: CYN contributors
profiles.description: Separate 6.3-million-parameter offline denoising experiment, plus FlowSense intensity, rhythmic onset and buildup/breakdown analysis. Trained on synthetic audio only. Not an emotional-understanding model, not a Windows live-DSP plug-in, and not compatible with the 209-weight Cyn AI Hub importer. View the experimental ZIP and benchmark; your current AI remains unchanged.
